meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did I hear it from him?
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what you based it on.

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.
Nothing on his record, then, and I'll want that in writing. But a rewrite for what? You still haven't told me what that zero rests on.
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
Good. Now show me what you actually have on Owen's essay.
So will you agree to the rewrite?
Not on nothing. Agreeing to a rewrite before I've seen a single piece of evidence would be admitting something, and I'm not doing that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you apologised for entering Owen's zero before contacting me and agreed that nothing will be placed on his record. I still expect the zero withdrawn unless you show me evidence tied to Owen's own work, and I will not agree to any rewrite before I have seen it. I expect that commitment from you in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she agreed to nothing, you committed that nothing goes on his record, and she still wants the zero withdrawn or real evidence shown before she will consider a rewrite; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was not reached because no evidence was ever put on the table.
What moved her: you committed to keeping it off his record, which met the one thing she will never give up.
What cost ground: you asked her to agree to the rewrite before showing anything, which to her meant admitting something on Owen's behalf.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked what the zero rested on, show her one dated document from Owen's own work that she can check herself before you ask her to accept the rewrite.
